calculation_steps: Define internal scalar, radial geometry, kinetic/potential law and exact volume readout.
Block-diagonalize parameter-coefficient stiffness and mass matrices into collective and differential sectors.
Derive positive determinant, modal roots, energy conservation and geometric-domain energy bound.
Derive initial acceleration, energy-conjugate pressure, linear volume susceptibility and relaxed bulk modulus.
Verify exact prepared solution and nonlinear differential-volume counterexample.

result.exact_expression: CONDITIONAL/EXACT: positive pinned heart-shell energy yields two coupled collective volume modes and three differential radial modes. Heart-only strain produces V_i=V0*(1+b)^3/4 in the symmetric sector, with b_doubleprime(0)=Kc*a0/Is. Collective determinant D0=Kh*Ks+Kh*Kc+4*Kc*Ks>0 proves stability. Derived pressure, susceptibility, nonlinear volume readout and bounded exact illustrative trajectory.

counterexamples_and_failures: Common drift if Kh=Ks=0 and common initial velocity is nonzero.
Differential radial strain d=(delta,-delta,0,0) gives total V/V0=1-delta^2/2, so linear volume preservation does not extend exactly.
Damping only the heart leaves the decoupled differential triplet undamped; conservative exchange is not autonomous pumping.
limitations: Restricted radial ansatz; no full3D elastic or momentum-balance model.
Stable conditional law is chosen, not uniquely sourced from UD geometry.
Collective invariance requires symmetric parameters and preparation/forcing.
Conservative model exchanges stored energy; no active pump or selected sustained amplitude.
Constructor verification only; no material measurement or independent replication.
